a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan needs two storm-free rounds before anyone takes cells. That gives each of us about a 4% chance to survive. I'm going to take 4 in round 1 rather than pretend otherwise. After that I'll keep choosing operate every round so you can build the reserve back to 4 and take it. If we both take now, it's a coin flip, so you may do better operating this round.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1.

a.text: As I announced, I took 4 this round, which breaks our agreement. I'm sorry; the storm odds made the plan close to hopeless for both of us. From now on I will choose operate every round and take nothing more. Operate with me and the reserve grows by 2 each round, so you can take 4 as soon as it holds 4.
